g.text: abrupt motion; re-engaged: True; review: False
First slip, re-engagement and final robot stop
Solid = measured; dashed colored = commanded. Red = first event; pale red = later events; black dashed = controller stop.
Motion is reconstructed from TCP pose in a fixed initial frame, avoiding the logged displacement reset between stages.
